notes.text: Don't retry the refresh_token grant as is, not even via withRetry. Keyline rotates refresh tokens and revokes the whole family when a used one is re-sent. A timeout can hit after the server rotated, so a plain retry signs every device out (keyline/security.md).
notes.author: codex

notes.text: Keyline ignores Idempotency-Key. Safe retry: send one Keyline-Retry-Token header (a UUID) reused across all attempts of the same refresh, via transport.post(path, body, { headers }). Keyline then replays the first response for 60 s (keyline/request-headers.md).
notes.author: codex

notes.text: SessionGuard retries an API call once after a 401. A refresh that fails with 400 invalid_grant is never retried: the family is gone, so sign the user out.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: post() rejects with TransportError (code ETIMEDOUT or ECONNRESET) only when no HTTP response arrived. Extra headers go in options.headers.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: withRetry is for Tokenbox API calls (ADR 0003). Don't wrap Keyline's refresh-token grant in it: a blind retry after a lost response trips token-family reuse detection. Keyline needs its own Keyline-Retry-Token header, not Idempotency-Key.
